sources.enabled_by_default: Default of ExportSettings.model_card_panel and of the --model-card-panel flag. Off: the card is always in the manifest; the panel is shown on request only (#15150 E2).
sources.position: Corner of the frame: top-left, top-right, bottom-left or bottom-right. Top corners start under the view label (where the colour key, top-left, and the impact card, top-right, also sit); bottom corners sit hud_layout_settings.json panel_gap_px above the bottom HUD rows.
sources.font_px: Panel font size in pixels (13 px stays legible at 640x480 and keeps six rows clear of the HUD at 1280x720).
sources.opacity: Darkening under the panel (0.62, as the impact card and the ellipsoid panel).
sources.fields: Card fields in panel order, each with its row label and the value keys, in order, whose first present entry is shown for a record value (a dotted key reads a nested record). A field missing from the list is not drawn.
sources.line_format: Row text; placeholders {label}, {value} and {tag}. The tag is also drawn as the right-hand column with tag_format.
sources.tag_format: Text of the right-hand tag column; placeholder {tag}.
sources.max_value_chars: Longest value text; a longer one is cut with '...' so the panel stays compact.
sources.unknown_text: Shown for a field tagged unknown, or a record value with none of its keys.
sources.tag_colours: 8-bit RGB of a row per provenance tag (model_card.TAGS).
